race.description: Welcome Back John H Mdn Plate
race.comment: NAKED LIGHT (4) made significant late ground last start to get up for third over 1000m at Bendigo in a race won by the classy Semantics. Getting within 3-1/4 lengths of her looks good form for a race like this. CHANDLER (2) is a Paddy Payne first starter who comes here off a trial win, which hints at a big debut showing. CAPITAL CHARLIE (1) is a 4YO who's taken time getting to the races, but a second and win at last two jumpouts show why connections have persisted. OTTALAUS (5) is yet to break through after seven starts but is not far off a win. Placed two back then missed the frame but was thereabouts last time over 1000m at Tatura but gets blinkers here.
